reason: A Web Settings plugin that provides workspace-aware skill browsing and controls for enabling or disabling user-level and project skills.

summaries.zh: 在 Web 设置中提供按工作区组织的技能管理页面，用于搜索并启用或停用用户级和项目级技能。
summaries.en: Adds a workspace-aware Skills page to Web Settings for searching and enabling or disabling user-level and project skills.

capabilities: Adds a Skills management page to Web Settings
Provides a local HTTP route for the skill catalog
Searches and displays user-level and project skills
Enables or disables managed skills by user or workspace scope
Persists skill toggle state in the settings document
